text: Hey, quick question—how exactly are Zendesk tickets getting into Gainsight? I’m trying to troubleshoot why some tickets aren’t showing up for a few accounts.

Hey Mei, so Zendesk syncs directly into Gainsight using the Connectors (not Connectors 2.0, that’s a different thing). There’s a bit in the handbook about this, but basically, sometimes the sync can get disrupted because of how Zendesk, Gainsight, and Salesforce talk to each other.

One thing to check: Zendesk doesn’t send the Org ID over to Salesforce automatically. We did a one-time upload of those IDs into Salesforce, and then Gainsight pulls them in via Connectors 2.0. If the Org ID is missing, tickets might not match up with the right account in Gainsight.
Ah, that makes sense. So if an account’s missing the Zendesk Org ID in Salesforce, the tickets won’t show up in Gainsight for that company?

Exactly. If you’re seeing gaps, try re-importing the Zendesk Org IDs into Salesforce for those accounts. That usually fixes it. There’s an open issue about this too, but for now, that’s the workaround.
